title: Northlake provider configuration
description: Common settings for the disposable localhost Keycloak provider.

groups.title: Provider
groups.description: The identity-provider name, realm, and public localhost address.

fields.label: Provider display name
fields.help: Shown on the Keycloak login and account pages.

fields.label: Realm key
fields.help: Lowercase localhost realm identifier, such as northlake.

fields.label: Public provider base URL
fields.help: HTTPS origin used for issuer, discovery, metadata, and browser links.

fields.label: HTTPS port
fields.help: Loopback port published by Docker. A changed port takes effect after restarting the stack.

fields.label: Configuration preset
fields.help: Phase 1 intentionally provides one ordinary baseline.

groups.title: Application
groups.description: Where Northlake returns users after the selected protocol flow.

fields.label: EnergyHippo application home URL
fields.help: Used only as the registered application landing page and logout return.

groups.title: OpenID Connect
groups.description: Enable the existing modern and retained legacy test clients.

fields.label: Enable OIDC clients
fields.help: Discovery remains a realm endpoint; this controls the EEMSuite client registrations.

fields.label: Exact OIDC redirect URIs
fields.help: One absolute HTTPS callback per line. Wildcards are not accepted.

groups.title: SAML 2.0
groups.description: Enable the ordinary Standard SAML client used by the baseline lab.

fields.label: Enable SAML client
fields.help: Phase 1 configures only the Standard profile. Saml2Int remains available through the existing environment file until Phase 5.

fields.label: Exact SAML ACS URLs
fields.help: One absolute HTTPS assertion-consumer URL per line.

fields.label: Exact SAML logout URLs
fields.help: One absolute HTTPS single-logout URL per line.
